entities.name: PMID:25430589
observations: Murine adipose stem cell-derived iPSCs yielded viable, fertile adult mice by tetraploid complementation; offspring were reported as entirely derived from reprogrammed iPSCs.

entities.name: Adipose iPSC tetraploid test
observations: Tetraploid complementation yielding viable, fertile adult mice provides stringent functional evidence of pluripotency for the specific murine adipose stem cell-derived iPSC lines studied.
Search found no distinct additional adipose-derived MSC/stromal iPSC tetraploid-complementation study; do not generalize the demonstrated result to all adipose-derived iPSC lines.
